title: Skincare Routine for Pigmentation: A Simple Morning and Night Plan
ex: A calm morning and night skincare routine for pigmentation-prone skin in India, with sunscreen tips, skin-type advice and when to see a dermatologist.
rt: Skincare Routine for Pigmentation: Day and Night | Mirc Glow
rd: A simple skincare routine for pigmentation: morning steps for uneven skin tone, a night routine for dark spots, sunscreen tips and when to see a doctor.
quick: A skincare routine for pigmentation needs three steady steps: a gentle cleanser, a spot-focused moisturiser with ingredients like kojic acid, alpha arbutin or niacinamide at night, and SPF 30 sunscreen every morning. Follow it for 8 to 12 weeks for a more even-looking complexion.
facts: Daily sunscreen is the most important step for pigmentation-prone skin.
Skin renews roughly every 4 to 6 weeks.
Irritation from scrubs or picking can leave new marks.
Large, symmetrical patches may be melasma and need a dermatologist.
